description: HIFLD Open Principal Ports is a data set archived in DataLumos, the ICPSR archive of US government data, from the decommissioned Homeland Infrastructure Foundation-Level Data (HIFLD) Open portal (Waterborne Commerce Statistics Center. U.S. Army Corps of Engineers; Department of Homeland Security). The principal port file contains USACE port codes, geographic location, names, and commodity tonnage summaries (total tons, domestic, foreign, imports and exports) for principal USACE ports for CY 2022. Coverage: the United States (US); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and DataLumos (ICPSR) normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-datalumos-repository.
